[SWS_PER_00472]
d
Persistency
shall use the error codes defined in
ara::per::
PerErrc
to report problems to the calling
application
via
ara::core::Result
.
Vendors of
Persistency
may add their own errors to
ara::per::PerErrc
, using
codes above
255
.
c
(RS_AP_00128)
ara::per::PerErrc
belongs to the
ara::per::PerErrorDomain
, which can be
used by an
application
to classify returned errors.
